summary: Unleash Live is a Sydney-founded enterprise computer vision company that raised an A$17 million Series B in May 2025 to expand in the Americas and Europe and marked ten years in September 2026. Meghan Hay has run finance since 2019 (Head of Finance, then Financial Controller since July 2023; Head of Finance on the company site) and is the single named finance contact.

sources.title: Unleash Live accelerates global growth with A$17M Series B Raise
Meghan Hay post: Unleash live announces Series A raise

claims.text: Unleash Live's own site says it is an enterprise industrial computer vision company founded in Sydney, Australia.
Meghan Hay's LinkedIn profile lists her as Financial Controller at Unleash live (current) since July 2023, and the company's About page lists her as Head of Finance.
Meghan describes her skills as budgeting, forecast modelling, cash flow projection, board reporting, governance compliance and full-cycle government grants management.
claims.quote: Skilled in budgeting, forecast modelling, cash flow projection, board reporting, governance compliance, full-cycle government grants management

claims.text: As Head of Finance (2019 to 2023) Meghan reviewed commercial terms and managed key supplier relationships including AWS.
claims.quote: review commercial terms and manage relationships with key external supply partners including AWS

claims.text: Unleash Live closed an A$17 million Series B in May 2025 to expand across the Americas and Europe.
claims.quote: Unleash Live closed an A$17 million Series B round to accelerate global expansion across the Americas and Europe

claims.text: Unleash Live marked ten years in September 2026 and counts BHP, Alcoa and Chevron among its major enterprise clients.
claims.quote: Unleash Live counts BHP, Alcoa and Chevron as major enterprise clients

claims.text: Unleash live's workforce is distributed across 6 countries including Australia, Germany, the United States, the UAE and Ecuador.
claims.quote: Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including Australia, Germany, United States, United Arab Emirates, and Ecuador).

hooks.text: Post Series B international expansion means more entities, currencies and enterprise contracts for a small finance function.
Meghan's remit spans board reporting and grants as well as the books, so reconciliation time competes with higher-value work.
Ten-year milestone and big-name clients give a timely, positive opening.

risks.text: Meghan's title varies by source (Financial Controller on LinkedIn since 2023; Head of Finance on company site; CFO on an NSW government vendor page); confirm before use.
Overseas entities and finance headcount beyond Meghan are not verified; a larger team may exist after the Series B.

gaps: No finance job ads or recent posts by Meghan found.
Accounting system (e.g. Xero, NetSuite) not found.

I built Vert to turn 4 hours of manual reconciliation into 5 minutes, with every match traceable. How much of your month-end is reconciliation today?
